description: This file defines a ViewModel class for handling Google Sign-In flow in an Android TV application. It manages sign-in initiation, processes the sign-in account, and updates sign-in status.

classes.name: SignInViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel to handle Google Sign-In for TV-compatible flow, manages sign-in process and updates sign-in state.

methods.name: startGoogleSignIn
methods.description: Initiates Google Sign-In intent for the user.

methods.name: handleSignIn
methods.description: Processes Google Sign-In account result, stores token, and updates sign-in status.
